The '''Battle of Ashas Ree''' was a conflict of the [[Great Galactic War]], waged around [[3660 BBY]]. After [[Battle of Korriban (3660 BBY)|failed]] [[Battle of Ziost|attacks]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]], launched an attack on the [[Ashas Ree/Legends|Ashas Ree]]&mdash;a world in the heart of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] territory. The planet was defended by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] and [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Army]] under the command of [[Darth Angral]] and [[Darth Malgus]]. Despite the tenacity of Master Zallow and his [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] forces, the Jedi and his comrades lost the battle and were forced to fall back to [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Daniel Wallace]], author of ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', originally planned for the attack on Ashas Ree to be an assault on the Imperial capital of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], but his first draft was vetoed by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith_15.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Official ''Book of Sith'' Endnotes (part 2)|date=2012-03-05}}</ref>
